BasicControl.ContentBeforeVideo: Press to move and use to move your camera. Press to jump and to crouch.
BasicControl.ContentAfterVideo: Approach and press to interact with the object. As you progress through the game, more controls will become available.

BuildingMode.ContentBeforeVideo: Press to open the Build panel. Tap any structure icon to enter building mode. When the build panel is open, use to drag icons into the hotbar at the bottom of the screen. Structures in the hotbar can be built directly by pressing shortcut keys -.
BuildingMode.ContentAfterVideo: In building mode, press to rotate the structure. Hold and drag for batch building. Some structures have multiple forms. You can toggle their forms with .

LayBelts.ContentBeforeVideo:
Automated production becomes possible with conveyor belts.
Conveyor belts can transport materials/products between storage boxes and lab devices.
LayBelts.ContentAfterVideo:
When laying conveyor belts by dragging, they will automatically connect to device interfaces on both ends.
Dragging over an existing belt lets you create splitters or mergers.
Initial conveyor belt speed: 60/min.

RawProductionDevice.ContentBeforeVideo: Basic production devices (table saws, stone crushers) consume raw materials to continuously produce refined materials. Hold or use interaction panel to add extra raw materials.
RawProductionDevice.ContentAfterVideo:
Some basic production devices (e.g. table saws) can take in materials from conveyor belts.
Alternatively, you can add raw materials via catapults.

ActiveCraftingDevice.ContentBeforeVideo:
Devices such as Assemblers, Athanors, and Alembics are advanced crafting devices.
They require configured recipes (unlocked through the Research panel) to operate.
ActiveCraftingDevice.ContentAfterVideo: You can open the interaction panel to set recipes,  manually add materials, or take products (except liquids).

PassiveCraftingDevice.ContentBeforeVideo:
Grinders, Crucibles and Extractors are automated devices.
Automated devices do not need recipe setup. Simply feed raw materials via conveyor belts to get started.
PassiveCraftingDevice.ContentAfterVideo: Press to open the catalog panel and view all automated processing relationships.

HeatingEquipment.ContentBeforeVideo:
Heating devices consume fuel to generate heat.
All lab devices that require heat must be built on top of heating devices.
HeatingEquipment.ContentAfterVideo:
Refuel manually in the interaction panel or automatically using conveyor belts.
Heat is measured in Pyra (P). Fuel burns faster with more heating devices.

Pipes.ContentBeforeVideo:
Liquids and gases are transported via pipelines.
Pipelines have no directional flow. Interact with pipelines to view their contents.
Pipes.ContentAfterVideo: When building pipelines, press to toggle between horizontal and vertical. For vertical pipelines, press to toggle between X/Y planes.

GoodsNShelves.ContentBeforeVideo: Interact with the shelf and set up your items for sale, then press to restock. The number of items a shelf can hold varies depending on item size.
GoodsNShelves.ContentAfterVideo:
Apart from manual restocking, you can also use catapult for automatic restocking.
Special items (e.g., potions) can only be sold on specific shelves.

ConveyerLift.ContentBeforeVideo: Conveyor lifters transport items vertically. In building mode, press to toggle upwards/downwards.
ConveyerLift.ContentAfterVideo: Before building, press to rotate the bottom. Then hold and drag upward. While holding to drag upward, press to rotate the top.

ThrowingDevice.ContentBeforeVideo: Press to interact with catapults and set throwing targets. There must be no obstacles on the throwing path, and some catapults have distance and angle restrictions.
ThrowingDevice.ContentAfterVideo: Throwable targets: hopper conveyors, shelves, and basic production devices like iron smelters and cauldrons.

PlantHerbs.ContentBeforeVideo: After applying seeds to seed plots, wait to harvest.

AutoNursery.ContentBeforeVideo:
You can use fertilizers in the Magic Nursery to automatically produce plants.
The rate of plant output is based on the fertility of Fertilizer.
AutoNursery.ContentAfterVideo:
Select seeds in interaction panel. Seeds will not be consumed.
Nutrient Value is measured in V (Vita). Different fertilizers have different maximum fertility.
Fertilizers can be added manually or supplied via conveyor belts.

RollerCoaster.ContentBeforeVideo:
Want more than shop profits? Build thrilling roller coaster tracks for extra revenue!
Visitors board sightseeing carts using transformation magic, accelerating downhill for adrenaline-filled tours.
RollerCoaster.ContentAfterVideo:
Longer tracks yield higher ticket revenue, and faster average speeds encourage more generous tips.
Interact with track stations to view route revenue projections.

HouseBuilding.ContentBeforeVideo: Upgrading Building Tool at the Workbench unlocks the ability to build floors and walls.
HouseBuilding.ContentAfterVideo:
When placing floors, aim at upper wall section to create ceilings. The same applies to walls.
Walls and floors cannot be copied in blueprint mode.

AutoCashier.ContentBeforeVideo:
Automatic Cashier is available for purchase in the Shop.
Open the Build menu and find Automatic Cashier, then build it on the Checkout Table to ring up customers automatically.
AutoCashier.ContentAfterVideo:
One Automatic Cashier can hold 10k coins. Once full, it will stop working.
You can interact with an Automatic Cashier to take its coins or connect a conveyor belt to automatically output coins.

ShopKeeping.ContentBeforeVideo: Increasing your shop's Recognition level raises its reputation and attracts more customers.
ShopKeeping.ContentAfterVideo:
Shop foot traffic will increase as Shop Reputation increases.
Shop Reputation is displayed to the right of the day number on the heads-up display.

HouseBuilding2.ContentBeforeVideo:
When constructing a building module (floor or wall), you must ensure it has sufficient support.
If the module under construction appears yellow, it can still be built, but its support capacity is approaching the limit.
HouseBuilding2.ContentAfterVideo:
Mutual support can only be provided between building modules.
Building modules can typically provide powerful support vertically, but support is relatively limited horizontally.

DispatchPortal.ContentBeforeVideo: After unlocking a purchase contract, you can sell the corresponding goods in bulk through the Dispatch Portal at below-market prices. Buyers have limited daily demand.
DispatchPortal.ContentAfterVideo: After completing enough orders, you can apply for a higher-tier supplier recognition to unlock more purchase contracts.

SupplyPortal.ContentBeforeVideo:
The Purchasing Portal can fully automate the purchase of raw materials sold in the shop.
Coins can be replenished manually or automatically via conveyor belts.
SupplyPortal.ContentAfterVideo: The Purchasing Portal accepts any type of coin and will automatically exchange them during purchase.

ShopKeeping2.ContentBeforeVideo: Customers will only browse goods on shelves they can reach. Blocked shelves that customers cannot reach will display the icon.
ShopKeeping2.ContentAfterVideo: At night, going to sleep will close the shop and clear out all customers. Upgrade your Potion Belt to reduce sleep time. Once sleep time reaches zero, you can stay open all night.

AreaSelection.ContentBeforeVideo: Use Area Selection in Bulk Delete or Clone mode to select multiple items at once.
AreaSelection.ContentAfterVideo: Hold and drag to define the area in the X/Y planes. Release , then move vertically to adjust the height of the area. Finally, release to complete the selection.

ShrinkMachine.ContentBeforeVideo:
The Transmuter reshapes your body into any item. Load a transformation potion and the desired item, then step inside to activate.
Certain special items unlock additional abilities when transformed.
ShrinkMachine.ContentAfterVideo: After transforming, interact with the Transmuter again to revert. You can also use the Unstuck function to force a revert.

Catalyst.ContentBeforeVideo: Adding different catalysts to the Advanced Athanor provides various production buffs.
Catalyst.ContentAfterVideo: Each catalyst has a fixed number of charges, and the charge cost per use varies depending on the recipe. Multiple catalysts can take effect simultaneously.

Lift.ContentBeforeVideo: To build a passenger lift, first build a lift shaft. Hold the left mouse button and drag to adjust its height. Once the lift shaft has been built, additional landings can be added or removed.
Lift.ContentAfterVideo: Interact with the lever outside a landing to call the lift. Once inside the lift car, interact with the lever to select your destination floor.

WagonSystem.ContentBeforeVideo: A complete wagon logistics system consists of four devices: the Wagon Launch Station, Wagon Loader, Wagon Unloader, and Wagon Receiving Station. Build a track connecting all four devices to create a complete wagon route.
WagonSystem.ContentAfterVideo: To get a wagon running, first craft one, then place it into a Wagon Launch Station manually or feed it in via a conveyor belt. Once fully charged, the wagon will automatically enter the track and begin running.

WagonFilterRule.ContentBeforeVideo: A wagon's color and tag can be set at the Wagon Launch Station.

RideTracks.ContentBeforeVideo: Use the Transmuter to transform into a wagon and ride along the tracks you've built.
RideTracks.ContentAfterVideo: Simply approach and interact with a Wagon Launch Station to get started. You can transport packages as usual while riding, and leave the tracks at any time.

CargoLift.ContentBeforeVideo: To build a cargo lift, first build a Cargo Lift Shaft. Hold the left mouse button and drag to adjust its height. Once the shaft is built, you can add or remove different types of lift landings on each of its four sides.
CargoLift.ContentAfterVideo: The cargo lift platform moves continuously back and forth between the highest and lowest landings, stopping at landings where packages need to be loaded or unloaded.
